verdict.rationale: Worldsmith builds a simulated world from a user's plain-language description, which is a first-party natural-language way to drive one core workflow. Semantic search over event content gives some loosely natural-language querying of telemetry. Other operations (writing tasks, running evaluations, comparing versions) are documented through the browser UI and SDKs rather than natural-language commands. Missing for 10: a general natural-language command interface across the product, natural-language control of tasks, evaluations and agent versions, detail on how Worldsmith's description-driven building works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
